template.name: UniversalMetricEntry
template.description: Universal template that works with any table having metric_name, metric_value, timestamp attributes
template.query: mutation UniversalMetricEntry($tableId: ID!, $content: String!, $metricName: String!, $metricValue: String!, $timestamp: String!) { createNode(input: { tableId: $tableId, content: $content, attributes: [ { identifier: "metric_name", value: $metricName }, { identifier: "metric_value", value: $metricValue }, { identifier: "timestamp", value: $timestamp } ] }) { success node { id content } } }
template.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": { "tableId": { "type": "string", "description": "Target table ID (part of composite key)", "enum": ["103", "104"] }, "content": { "type": "string", "description": "Descriptive content for the metric entry" }, "metricName": { "type": "string", "description": "Metric identifier (unique within table scope)" }, "metricValue": { "type": "string", "description": "Metric value" }, "timestamp": { "type": "string", "description": "ISO timestamp" } }, "required": ["tableId", "content", "metricName", "metricValue", "timestamp"] }
